# FactWorld data snapshot

The four unmodified modules `config.py`, `world.py`, `oracle.py`, and `render.py` come from [FactWorld](https://github.com/ianbarber/factworld) at commit `6f0ef0eb9d484b1fff4d2192711fe486cdaa989b`. They are distributed under the accompanying MIT license. Their SHA-256 values are recorded in each run's metadata.

The small package initializer and packaging file are specific to this snapshot. The experiment requires only these data, symbolic-oracle, and rendering modules; the training and evaluation backends are outside its dependency surface.
